title: Project Preserve Destiny code name Staunch 118
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Project Preserve Destiny code name Staunch 118, about 1991 at NSA training site, Maryland, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
plain: A former Army sergeant named Dan Sherman says that around 1991, at a training site in Maryland run by the National Security Agency (the NSA, the US government's code-breaking and communications spy agency), he was part of a project called Preserve Destiny. On a podcast with host Jesse Michels, he gives its code name as Staunch 118. If true, it would mean the government ran a secret named programme he says he was hired into, one he links to speaking with aliens.
